name.description: Unique name for the selective rule in the auto attendant.

businessSchedule.description: Name of the location's business schedule which determines when this selective call forwarding rule is in effect.

holidaySchedule.description: Name of the location's holiday schedule which determines when this selective call forwarding rule is in effect.

forwardTo.description: Controls what happens when the rule matches including the destination number for the call forwarding.

callsFrom.description: Settings related to the rule matching based on incoming caller ID.

callsTo.description: Settings related to the rule matching based on the destination number.
